systems.name: 1.1 MapBuild Protocol Implementation
systems.notes: Implement the deterministic UDMF→PWAD builder with canonical lump order, self-healing (REJECT/BLOCKMAP regeneration), and corridor/lighting rules. Must produce byte-stable outputs across runs.
tasks: Build UDMF→PWAD converter with lump order enforcement
Auto-generate missing REJECT and BLOCKMAP lumps
Implement corridor-width and default-light checks
Ensure deterministic output (no RNG, seed=0)

systems.name: 1.2 Audit Protocol & Validation
systems.notes: Create MD5-per-lump checker, magic-byte typing, Freedoom Phase 2 baselines, and cross-link validation between LINEDEFS↔SIDEDEFS↔VERTEXES↔SECTORS. Output audit CSV/JSON.
tasks: Implement MD5 hash per lump with delta reporting
Magic-byte type detection (PNG, WAV, etc.)
Cross-index integrity checks between map lumps
REJECT/BLOCKMAP sanity checks with auto-repair

systems.name: 1.3 WadParse Utility
systems.notes: In-house WAD parser that recognises map markers (E#M#|MAP##) and enforces the 10-lump chain. Emit census tables and validation JSON for SRP.
tasks: Parse WAD directory and extract lump metadata
Detect and validate map marker lumps
Generate census tables (thing counts, line counts)
Output validation JSON for SRP consumption

systems.name: 1.4 Self-Reflection Protocol (SRP) Core
systems.notes: Implement Logic Brain/Logic Loose modes, Dreamstate Cycle, meta-audit, historical confidence tracking, and reflexive logging. The SRP checks the checker.
tasks: Implement mode switching (Logic Brain vs Logic Loose)
Meta-audit: hash the ruleset itself and detect drift
Rolling confidence per repair (e.g., REJECT regen 99.9%)
Schedule synthetic test-map builds for threshold validation

systems.name: 1.5 Build Pipeline & Automation
systems.notes: Scriptable pipeline that runs MapBuild → Audit → SRP report in one command. Configuration via JSON stubs. Generate map_overview.csv and map_issues.csv.
tasks: Create CLI wrapper for MapBuild + Audit + SRP
Define config.json schema (mode, thresholds, etc.)
Generate build artifacts (CSV, validation JSON, report)
Test byte-stability over multiple runs
